cohort: The study included 2,334 peripartum women who had a documented Pap smear prior to delivery.
finding: The presence of HPV was positively associated with an increase in quantitative blood loss (QBL) and postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) at the time of delivery, particularly for women undergoing operative vaginal or cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The presence of HPV was significantly associated with increased QBL and increased odds for PPH in women who had an operative vaginal delivery or a cesarean delivery.
